# Remaining schemas, part 1 (AcceptedResult–BookingUnitItemWriteRequest)

## List envelopes

Array wrappers with no fields of their own. The item schema carries everything.

- **AvailabilityBatchList**: array of `AvailabilityBatchRow`. Returned by `POST /availability/batch`.
- **AvailabilityCalendarBatchList**: array of `AvailabilityCalendarBatchRow`. Returned by `POST /availability/calendar/batch`.
- **AvailabilityCalendarList**: array of `AvailabilityCalendar`. Returned by `POST /availability/calendar`.
- **AvailabilityList**: array of `Availability`. Returned by `POST /availability`.
- **BookingList**: array of `Booking`. Returned by `GET /bookings`, `GET /memberships/bookings`.

## `AcceptedResult`

Returned by `POST /gifts/{uuid}/notify`, `POST /orders/{orderId}/notify`.

Required: `status`.

- **status** (string, required): Current status value. Example: `"accepted"`.
- **requestId** (string, optional): Request identifier. Example: `"req_20260514_7f29b8"`.
- **message** (string, optional): Message value. Example: `"Request accepted for asynchronous processing."`.

## `AvailabilityBatchRequest`

Request schema for `/availability/batch`. Includes the same selectors as `/availability`, with optional product filters.

- **availabilityId** (string, optional): Single availability identifier (ISO-8601 local date or date-time). Example: `"2026-05-14T09:00:00-04:00"`.
- **availabilityIds** (string[], optional): Multiple availability identifiers. Example: `["2026-05-14T09:00:00-04:00", "2026-05-15T09:00:00-04:00"]`.
- **currency** (string, optional): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **localDate** (string (date), optional): Local date in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-14"`.
- **localDateEnd** (string (date), optional): End of local date range in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-21"`.
- **localDateStart** (string (date), optional): Start of local date range in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-14"`.
- **localTime** (string, optional): Local start time in the product timezone (HH:MM). Example: `"09:00"`.
- **productIds** (string[], optional): Optional multi-product filter. Example: `["e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681", "prod_london_hop_on_hop_off"]`.
- **units** (AvailabilityUnitRequest[], optional): Unit selections used for availability and pricing context.
- **uuid** (string, optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **offerCode** (string, optional): Offer code to evaluate for pricing and eligibility. From capability `octo/offers`. Example: `"SUMMER25"`.
- **extras** (AvailabilityExtraRequest[], optional): Extra selections used for availability and pricing context. From capability `octo/extras`.
- **rentalDurationId** (string, optional): Rental duration identifier for rental products. From capability `octo/rentals`. Example: `"rental_duration_2h"`.

With `octo/memberships`:

- **membership** (MembershipContext, optional).

## `AvailabilityBatchRow`

Returned by `POST /availability/batch`.

Required: `allDay`, `available`, `id`, `localDateTimeEnd`, `localDateTimeStart`, `openingHours`, `optionId`, `productId`, `status`, `statusMessage`, `utcCutoffAt`.

- **allDay** (boolean, required): Whether all day is enabled. Example: `false`.
- **available** (boolean, required): Whether this availability can be booked. Example: `true`.
- **capacity** (integer, optional, nullable): Capacity numeric value. Example: `2`.
- **id** (string (uuid), required): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"94cdd032-3d32-416d-b0a4-abf8b7495b8b"`.
- **localDateTimeEnd** (string (date-time), required): Local date time end timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-03-01T12:00:00-08:00"`.
- **localDateTimeStart** (string (date-time), required): Local date time start timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-03-01T09:00:00-08:00"`.
- **maxPaxCount** (integer, optional, nullable): Max pax count numeric value. Example: `2`.
- **maxUnits** (integer, optional, nullable): Max units numeric value. Example: `2`.
- **openingHours** (OpeningHoursRange[], required): List of opening hour values.
- **optionId** (string, required): Option identifier. Example: `"94cdd032-3d32-416d-b0a4-abf8b7495b8b"`.
- **paxCount** (integer, optional): Pax count numeric value. Example: `2`.
- **productId** (string, required): Product identifier. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **reference** (string, optional, nullable): Reference value. Example: `"REF-2026-001"`.
- **status** (string, required): Current status value. One of: `AVAILABLE`, `LIMITED`, `SOLD_OUT`, `FREESALE`, `CLOSED`. Example: `"AVAILABLE"`.
- **statusMessage** (string, required): Status message value. Example: `"Limited availability for this departure."`.
- **utcCutoffAt** (string (date-time), required): Utc cutoff at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **utcOnsaleAt** (string (date-time), optional, nullable): Utc onsale at timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Example: `"2026-05-14T13:00:00Z"`.
- **vacancies** (integer, optional, nullable): Vacancies numeric value. Example: `2`.

## `AvailabilityCalendarRequest`

Request schema for `/availability/calendar`.

Required: `productId`, `optionId`, `localDateStart`, `localDateEnd`.

- **productId** (string, required): Product ID or code. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **optionId** (string, required): Option ID or code. Use `DEFAULT` only when the product has no options. Example: `"94cdd032-3d32-416d-b0a4-abf8b7495b8b"`.
- **localDateStart** (string (date), required): Start of local date range in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-14"`.
- **localDateEnd** (string (date), required): End of local date range in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-21"`.
- **units** (AvailabilityUnitRequest[], optional): Unit selections used for availability and pricing context.
- **currency** (string, optional): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **uuid** (string, optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **offerCode** (string, optional): Offer code to evaluate for pricing and eligibility. From capability `octo/offers`. Example: `"SUMMER25"`.
- **extras** (AvailabilityExtraRequest[], optional): Extra selections used for availability and pricing context. From capability `octo/extras`.
- **rentalDurationId** (string, optional): Rental duration identifier for rental products. From capability `octo/rentals`. Example: `"rental_duration_2h"`.

With `octo/memberships`:

- **membership** (MembershipContext, optional).

## `AvailabilityExtraRequest`

Availability extra selector. From capability `octo/extras`.

Required: `id`, `quantity`.

- **id** (string (uuid), required): Extra identifier. Example: `"3d6f0a3a-59d4-4b16-a0c5-11d2d8a4e6b7"`.
- **quantity** (integer, required): Quantity for the selected extra. Example: `2`.
- **retail** (integer, optional): Custom retail amount in minor units. Required when the selected extra has `customRetail: true`. Example: `1500`.

## `AvailabilityRequest`

Request schema for `/availability`. `productId` and `optionId` are required, and at least one availability selector must be provided (`localDate`, `localDateStart`+`localDateEnd`, `availabilityId`, or `availabilityIds`).

Required: `productId`, `optionId`.

- **productId** (string, required): Product ID or code. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **optionId** (string, required): Option ID or code. Use `DEFAULT` only when the product has no options. Example: `"94cdd032-3d32-416d-b0a4-abf8b7495b8b"`.
- **availabilityId** (string, optional): Single availability identifier (ISO-8601 local date or date-time). Example: `"2026-05-14T09:00:00-04:00"`.
- **availabilityIds** (string[], optional): Multiple availability identifiers. Example: `["2026-05-14T09:00:00-04:00", "2026-05-15T09:00:00-04:00"]`.
- **units** (AvailabilityUnitRequest[], optional): Unit selections used for availability and pricing context.
- **currency** (string, optional): ISO 4217 currency code. Example: `"USD"`.
- **localDate** (string (date), optional): Local date in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-14"`.
- **localDateEnd** (string (date), optional): End of local date range in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-21"`.
- **localDateStart** (string (date), optional): Start of local date range in the product timezone (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: `"2026-05-14"`.
- **localTime** (string, optional): Local start time in the product timezone (HH:MM). Example: `"09:00"`.
- **uuid** (string, optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **offerCode** (string, optional): Offer code to evaluate for pricing and eligibility. From capability `octo/offers`. Example: `"SUMMER25"`.
- **extras** (AvailabilityExtraRequest[], optional): Extra selections used for availability and pricing context. From capability `octo/extras`.
- **rentalDurationId** (string, optional): Rental duration identifier for rental products. From capability `octo/rentals`. Example: `"rental_duration_2h"`.

With `octo/memberships`:

- **membership** (MembershipContext, optional).

## `AvailabilityUnitRequest`

Availability unit selector.

Required: `id`, `quantity`.

- **id** (string (uuid), required): Unit identifier. Example: `"3d6f0a3a-59d4-4b16-a0c5-11d2d8a4e6b7"`.
- **quantity** (integer, required): Quantity for the selected unit. Example: `2`.
- **weightValue** (number, optional): Total weight value for the selected unit quantity. Example: `20`.
- **weightUnit** (string, optional): Weight unit for `weightValue`. One of: `kg`, `lb`. Example: `"kg"`.

## `BookingConfirmRequest`

Request schema for booking confirmation. This endpoint documents contact updates and an optional reseller reference.

- **resellerReference** (string, optional): Reseller reference value. We highly recommend including a `resellerReference`. Example: `"RES-BOOK-10045"`.
- **contact** (Contact, optional): Contact details to apply during confirmation. Required if `options[x].requiredContactFields` from the products response has values.

## `BookingUnitItemWriteRequest`

Required: `unitId`.

- **unitId** (string, required): Unit identifier. Example: `"unit_adult"`.
- **contact** (Contact, optional): Contact object. Required if `options[x].units[x].requiredContactFields` from the products response has values. Each field specified will also be required.
- **resellerReference** (string, optional): Reseller reference value. Example: `"RES-BOOK-10045"`.
- **uuid** (string (uuid), optional): User-submitted UUID field that can be used to uniquely reference this resource and provide idempotency against repeat requests with the same UUID. Example: `"89fe0192-ddcd-430a-b285-e1396a4725d2"`.
- **weightUnit** (string, optional): Weight unit for the weight value. Possible values: `kg`, `lb` (the specification declares this set on `AvailabilityUnitRequest`; here it types the field as a plain string). Example: `"kg"`.
- **weightValue** (number, optional): Weight value for the selected units. Example: `20`.

With `octo/extras`:

- **extraItems** (ExtraItemRequest[], optional): Send one object per reserved extra. Include `retail` for custom retail extras.

With `octo/questions`:

- **questionAnswers** (QuestionAnswer[], optional).

With `octo/waivers`:

- **waiverFieldValues** (WaiverFieldValue[], optional): Waiver field values for this unit item. Required with `waiverId` when submitting a unit-level waiver.
- **waiverFile** (string, optional, nullable): Optional base64-encoded waiver file payload for offline/in-person completed waivers, or to store a rendered waiver copy on the booking unit item. Use a PDF data URI such as `data:application/pdf;base64,...`. Example: `"data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcTl8uXr..."`.
- **waiverId** (string (uuid), optional, nullable): Waiver template UUID selected for this unit item. Required with `waiverFieldValues` when submitting a unit-level waiver. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.
